DETERMINISTIC DECISION ENGINE

Turn a backlog into an explainable decision plan.

HOW IT WORKS

Five transparent stages.

01

Weighted scoring

Signals are multiplied by the selected mode’s weights.

02

Readiness checks

Tasks below the readiness gate are held back.

03

Dependencies

Blocked work waits until its prerequisites are complete or underway.

04

Resource constraints

Each scheduled task consumes the capacity it needs.

05

Explainable ranking

Every verdict includes its score and a deterministic reason.

ABOUT
